text_block_list.text:
—Spring. What Calstone Light O had been waiting for
more than anything was finally opened to traffic.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please take a look
at this majestic, gallant figure. This is...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"A direct bus to the hot spring resort!
How reliable. Let's get on board right away."
And so, we decided to head out on our reward hot springs trip, but...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I've noticed something.
This bus...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Aren't we meandering more than expected?
If possible, instead of sticking to roads,
let's just head straight there...
Even if it was called "direct," it didn't mean traveling in a literal straight line. Still, the bus safely arrived in the shortest time possible—
In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... That was the best bath ever.
Straight from the source, free-flowing hot springs...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The bath was so wonderful that
for a moment, I thought to myself...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah~ I don't care anymore.
Starting tomorrow, I don't wanna do anythiiing," she said.
choice_data_list: Ahaha, looks like it worked like a charm.
Ahaha, looks like it really did the trick, huh?

text_block_list.text:
"Soaking in the hot springs loosens both body and mind.
Even the always straightforward and earnest Calstone Light O
seemed to be truly relaxed from the bottom of her heart."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
The hot water was wonderful, but
there was just one disappointing thing...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
That I wasn't able to wash your back, Trainer.
I at least wanted you to let me do that much.
choice_data_list: You really didn't have to go that far...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: No, I really wanted to do it. I have complete confidence in myself.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Soaking the towel in soap,
I wash their back while filling every scrub with daily gratitude...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"First, back and forth with precision to verify the trajectory.
Before long—"

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Gradually—I'm getting into the groove!
I can flow even faster. More!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
O towel—become light itself!!
WROOOOOOAAARGH!
choice_data_list: Stop, stop! It's rubbing against me!

text_block_list.text:
...I really could have done without
the lightspeed back-scrubbing, honestly.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see, so you do not require assistance washing your back.
Then at the very least—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Would you let me take care of the soles of your feet,
Trainer?
choice_data_list: The soles of your feet? How?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
You rub it with a pumice stone. Do you know what pumice is?
It's the perfect stone for scrubbing the soles of your feet.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
If you rub it, the old dead skin comes right off
and makes it silky smooth.
Please, let me give you a pumice stone treatment!
choice_data_list: Well then... I think I will ask you to.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
By the way, regarding the course...

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Which would you prefer:
'Normal,' 'Speed of Light,' or 'Faster-Than-Light'?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
It feels a bit unsatisfying, but in that case...
(Scrub, scrub, scrub...)

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: What do you think, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: —Shall we pick up the pace?
choice_data_list: No, let's leave it as is!
No, let's keep it like this!

text_block_list.text:
The comfort of being groomed. And the occasional
spark of tension served as a nice accent—

It was a moment where I felt
an irreplaceable bond
with Calstone Light O...
